profile.name: 串口设备
profile.description: 通过 RS-232、RS-485 或 TTL 等串行接口与计算机通信的仪器、控制器或传感器。在实验室中常用于发送控制命令、读取测量数据，以及按字节或按行交换文本或二进制数据。
profile.description_en: An instrument, controller, or sensor that communicates with a computer through a serial interface such as RS-232, RS-485, or TTL. In laboratories it is commonly used to send control commands, read measurement data, and exchange text or binary data byte-by-byte or line-by-line.

registry.name: Open Standard Aio Serial
registry.description: Aio Serial是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, loop等操作。
